title: Robot Navigation With Recovery
description: A Nav2-style navigate-to-pose tree: plan a path (with retries) and follow it; when navigation fails, run recovery behaviors in escalating fallback order — clear costmaps, spin, back up, wait — then retry navigation.

custom_nodes.name: ComputePathToPose
custom_nodes.title: Compute Path To Pose
custom_nodes.description: Asks the planner for a path from the robot to the goal pose.

custom_nodes.name: FollowPath
custom_nodes.title: Follow Path
custom_nodes.description: Drives the robot along the planned path; fails if the robot gets stuck or the path becomes blocked.

custom_nodes.name: ClearCostmaps
custom_nodes.title: Clear Costmaps
custom_nodes.description: Cheapest recovery: wipes stale obstacle data so planning can see freed space.

custom_nodes.name: Spin
custom_nodes.title: Spin In Place
custom_nodes.description: Rotates in place to refresh sensor coverage around the robot.

custom_nodes.name: BackUp
custom_nodes.title: Back Up
custom_nodes.description: Reverses a short distance to escape a tight spot.

n1.name: RepeatUntilSuccess
n1.title: Retry Navigation
n1.description: The whole attempt loops until navigation succeeds or the retry budget runs out.

n2.name: Priority
n2.title: Navigate Or Recover
n2.description: Try to navigate; only when that fails does a recovery run.

n3.name: MemSequence
n3.title: Navigate
n3.description: A procedural checklist, so a long FollowPath is not restarted every tick.

n7.name: Sequence
n7.title: Recover
n7.description: Runs one recovery, then deliberately fails so the retry loop navigates again.

n12.name: Wait
n12.title: Wait
n12.description: Last resort: wait for the world to change (a door to open, a person to pass).

n13.name: Failer
n13.title: Recovery Done — Go Retry
n13.description: Forces the branch to fail so RepeatUntilSuccess ticks navigation again.
